description: This file defines the PersistentStreamProducer class, which implements asynchronous message production for persistent streams in Orleans. It manages message queuing, batch processing, and logging for stream producers.

classes.name: PersistentStreamProducer<T>
classes.description: A class responsible for producing messages to a persistent stream, supporting batch operations, error handling, and logging.

methods.name: PersistentStreamProducer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the stream producer with dependencies and setting up logging.

methods.name: OnNextAsync
methods.description: Sends a single message item to the stream asynchronously.

methods.name: OnNextBatchAsync
methods.description: Sends a batch of message items to the stream asynchronously.

methods.name: OnCompletedAsync
methods.description: Placeholder for completing the stream; currently not implemented.

methods.name: OnErrorAsync
methods.description: Placeholder for handling errors; currently not implemented.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup tasks; currently a no-op.

methods.name: LogCreatedPersistentStreamProducer
methods.description: Logs the creation of a persistent stream producer instance.
